subject: PrivHost architecture review & ops-owner alignment
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@medicaustech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PrivHost architecture review & ops-owner alignment

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (30m discovery)
- Primary goal: private/VPC deployment for PHI workflows, strict network isolation, and customer-managed KMS.
- Constraints: on-prem database connections over peering, egress restrictions, and SOC2 evidence path.
- Success criteria: infra runbook, ops-owner identified, and a scheduled 90-minute architecture review with our infra SME.

Proposed next step: 90-minute architecture review with networking + ops owners present. We want to:
- Walk through your network hanging points and firewall requirements
- Align on routing, peering, and IP ranges
- Confirm deployment model (VPC vs on-prem appliance) and rollout milestones

Available windows (all PDT):
- Thu 4/15: 09:30–11:00 or 14:00–15:30
- Fri 4/16: 10:00–11:30 or 16:00–17:30

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side should join (networking lead, ops owner, security reviewer)? If none of the above work, share two preferred windows and we’ll accommodate.

I’ve attached a lightweight MAP draft and a network diagram you shared — will update after the call.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jonas.weber@redwood.com]
[Attachment: MediCause-MAP-v0.2.xlsx]
[Attachment: medicaustech-network-drawing.pdf]

From: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@medicaustech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@medicaustech.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivHost architecture review & ops-owner alignment

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. Good summary. 

We’re keen to move forward. Carlos (cc’d) will be our DevOps lead and should join the architecture review. Our infosec lead is tied up this week but can attend the follow-up.

From the windows you proposed, Fri 4/16 10:00–11:30 PDT works best for Carlos and me. If you need a longer slot we can extend to 12:00. 

A few prep items from our side: 
- We’ll upload our VPC peering topology and current firewall rules (PDF) by EOD Thu.
- Please share a list of any VPC/subnet requirements you need in advance (NAT, egress rules, IP ranges).

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah Patel
Head of Product Operations | MediCauseTech
[sarah.patel@medicaustech.com]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@medicaustech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivHost architecture review & ops-owner alignment

Thanks Sarah — Fri 4/16 10:00–11:30 PDT works for our infra SME as well. I’ll lead the technical portion and Neha will cover compliance/ops runbook expectations.

Quick ask on prep so we can make the session actionable: 
- Please upload your VPC peering diagram and a redacted firewall ruleset (PDF) to the Drive link Jonas shared; I’ll confirm any missing items on Thursday.
- If you have a preferred CI/CD or runtime orchestration tool (Argo/Octopus/Jenkins), mention it in the Drive note.

Agenda (90m) — proposed
1) 10:00–10:10: Intros & goals
2) 10:10–10:40: Network topology & peering constraints (Carlos)
3) 10:40–11:10: Deployment options & Redwood topology recommendations (Marissa)
4) 11:10–11:25: Ops/runbook & compliance checklist (Neha)
5) 11:25–11:30: Next steps & owners

If that looks good I’ll send a calendar invite with the agenda and links. Also confirming we’ll need: 
- Carlos’s public IP ranges (for peering rules)
- Point of contact for support tickets during the POC

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[marissa.cole@redwood.com]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@medicaustech.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@medicaustech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Fri 4/16 10:00–11:30 PDT — PrivHost architecture review (invite + prep)

All — confirmed and calendar invite sent for Fri 4/16 10:00–11:30 PDT. Invite includes: Zoom link, Drive folder, and the MAP draft.

Prep checklist (please upload before 4/15 EOD unless noted):
- VPC peering topology PDF [Attachment: medicaustech-network-drawing.pdf] (Sarah/Carlos)
- Redacted firewall ruleset (PDF) (Sarah/Carlos)
- Carlos: public IP ranges for peering
- Point of contact for POC support tickets (name + email)

Immediate next actions from Redwood: 
- Marissa: bring recommended VPC/subnet patterns and a short checklist for NAT/egress rules
- Neha: send the ops/runbook template we use for Private deployments (will attach to the invite)
- Jonas: update MAP with milestones and a stub for procurement/terms — sharing via Drive now

Attachments included in thread: MediCause-MAP-v0.2.xlsx, medicaustech-network-drawing.pdf

Looking forward — this should make the technical review much more efficient.

Best,
